### To the Saints in Ephesus
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/saints-ephesus
Passage: Ephesians 1:1-2
Points:
- Paul's letter to the Ephesians has exerted an enduring, foundational influence on Christian theology and ministry.
- Early church tradition and historical evidence firmly support Pauline authorship during his imprisonment in Rome.
- Modern scholarly doubts based on vocabulary and sentence length underestimate Paul's literary skill and versatility.
- The letter lacks references to localized disputes because Paul intended it as a circular letter for multiple churches.
- Readers are encouraged to examine its core themes prayerfully to gain deeper insight into God's character and ways.
